description: The alarm panel receiver (GIGA/Opta 4.5.8+, SIA DC-09 over TCP/UDP): enabled, listeners, frame counters, troubles (AC, battery, tamper, communication, zone, supervision), per-partition state (disarmed / partial / armed / ALARM) with the last event code, zone and user, and the universal sensor each partition feeds. Monitoring only (no arming). Editor/admin level.

title: Alarm panel (SIA receiver)
